C.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying a fraction (e.g., reducing 3/12 to 1/4) without converting mixed/whole numbers

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or states a common denominator
A step scales numerators/denominators to express fractions with the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work proceeds directly to subtraction
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without aligning denominators between two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts by combining whole and fractional parts (e.g., (A−B) + (a/b − c/b))
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting forms without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the result after subtraction is already done

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies an integer result (e.g., 0/3 = 0, 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: The step only performs the subtraction without any reduction or re-expression
The step only finds a common denominator or converts mixed numbers prior to subtraction

B.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (ac+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only simplifying a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common (often least common) denominator for two fractions and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or common denominator for two denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to rewrite fractions with the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without aligning denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts), including handling zero and negative intermediate results.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts by combining whole and fractional parts (e.g., (A−B) + (a/b − c/b))
A step shows cancellation to zero (x − x = 0)
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting forms (conversion/common denominator) without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor (e.g., −3/12 → −1/4)
A step states or checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts between improper fraction and mixed number for the final presentation
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
Only finding a common denominator (this is not simplification of the result)

A.domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert number forms
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers as equivalent improper fractions (or fractions with a specified denominator) to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., 3 1/2 → 7/2).
A step rewrites an integer as a fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 → 15/5).
A step rewrites a fraction into an equivalent fraction with a new denominator as part of setup (not necessarily via LCM).
exclusion_criteria: Finding the least common multiple/common denominator strategy itself (tag S02 instead).
Performing the subtraction after forms are already aligned (tag S03 instead).
Reducing/simplifying the final fraction or converting to mixed number after subtraction (tag S04 instead).

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to express fractions with unlike denominators in equivalent forms.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds a common denominator or LCM for two denominators.
A step scales both fractions to that common denominator (e.g., 5/6 → 15/18 and 1/9 → 2/18).
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no common-denominator work is needed (tag S03 instead).
Only converting mixed/whole numbers without addressing unlike denominators (tag S01 instead).
Simplifying the result after subtraction (tag S04 instead).

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions once they share a denominator or are decomposed into compatible whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12).
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts and combines them (e.g., (4−2)+(4/12−7/12)).
A step handles zero results from subtracting equal quantities (e.g., 2/3 − 2/3 = 0).
exclusion_criteria: Work that is only about creating equivalent forms/common denominators (tag S01 or S02 instead).
Work that is only about simplifying/reducing or converting the final form (tag S04 instead).

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction (e.g., −3/12 → −1/4).
A step states or checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms.
A step converts between improper fraction and mixed number for the final expression (e.g., 7/4 = 1 3/4).
exclusion_criteria: The step is performing the subtraction itself (tag S03 instead).
The step is converting inputs to compatible forms before subtraction (tag S01/S02 instead).
